edges.reason: addLiquidity forwards msg.value to _addLiquidity which settles pending ETH before crediting new collateral.
_addLiquidity calls _settleTokens first, which can push ETH to the user before balances are updated.
removeLiquidity settles tokens before reserving the removal, leaving a payable external call in the path.
settleTokens delegates to _settleTokens which performs an ETH transfer to the caller.
ETH payout via _sendTokens happens before unremovedTokens[msg.sender] is deleted.
_sendTokens calls reserveEth.sendAsset which forwards ETH out of the reserve.
ReserveEth.sendAsset calls _transferETH, transferring value to an externally supplied user.
_transferETH uses a low-level call forwarding all gas to the recipient, enabling reentry.
_reserveAsset pushes ETH to the reserve contract with a low-level value call.
renewMaturity reserves the collateral share owed to liquidity removers.
renewMaturity refreshes bond group data and rolls the term.
_updateBondGroupData reads the latest oracle price.
_updateBondGroupData registers the SBT for the next term through the registrator.
trancheBonds queries the strategy for the tranche bond amounts.
trancheBonds deposits the required ETH into the DOTC exchange.
trancheBonds reverses a bond group back into collateral.
trancheBonds issues new bonds via the collateralized issuer.
_issueBonds calls BondMaker.issueNewBonds with ETH value attached.
liquidateBonds iterates bond groups through _liquidateBondGroup.
_liquidateBondGroup burns each bond of the group via _burnBond.
liquidateBonds withdraws the ETH allowance held in the DOTC exchange.
claimReward transfers the reward token to the caller.
_addLiquidity updates balance data for the liquidity move.
removeLiquidity updates balance data for the liquidity move.
_transferToken refreshes balance and reward data of both parties.
constructor creates the DOTC bond and ETH pools with the strategy fee base.
isActive and endCoolTime gate trancheBonds on block.timestamp, a miner-influenced value.
afterMaturity gates liquidateBonds on block.timestamp.
msg.sender indexes receivedCollaterals and unremovedTokens during liquidity accounting.
msg.sender is the owner of the share tokens being reserved for removal.
msg.sender is both the reward owner and the reward recipient.
msg.sender is the token sender in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender checked against the allowances mapping.
onlyBonusProvider requires msg.sender == OWNER in updateTotalReward.
ReserveEth.sendAsset is restricted by onlyOwner to msg.sender == owner.
renewMaturity reads currentTerm to derive the next term index.
_settleTokens reads shareData[term].totalCollateralPerToken to value the removal.
renewMaturity computes collateral per token from shareData.
_calcNextReward walks the totalRewards history to accumulate reward.
claimReward reads the caller's balance data before payout.
_transferToken checks the sender's balance before moving tokens.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowances mapping.
_settleTokens reads unremovedTokens[msg.sender] to compute unpaid ETH.
_settleTokens reads receivedCollaterals[msg.sender] to compute unsettled shares.
trancheBonds reads lastTrancheTime through the endCoolTime modifier.
renewMaturity uses totalReceivedCollateral to derive unsent tokens.
renewMaturity uses totalUnremovedTokens when computing the next total share.
_getSuitableBondGroup uses priceUnit to derive price candidates.
_addSuitableBondGroup uses termInfo strike price and maturity.
trancheBonds writes block.timestamp into lastTrancheTime.
renewMaturity writes the next term's share data.
claimReward zeroes the reward amount stored in balance.
changeSpread updates currentFeeBase after validating the strategy spread.
_transferToken writes the updated balances of sender and recipient.
updateTotalReward appends a new entry to totalRewards.
updateStartBondGroupId advances startBondGroupId.
renewMaturity raises isTotalSupplyDanger when the share supply could overflow.
liquidateBonds records liquidation progress in liquidationData.
approve writes the spender allowance.
_sendTokens pays ETH to msg.sender before the unremovedTokens reservation is cleared.
getCurrentPhase derives the phase from block.timestamp, a miner-influenced input.
removeLiquidity reserves the caller-supplied share amount.
the ETH recipient of _sendTokens is the user/msg.sender, an attacker-controllable address.
unsentETH is computed and transferred out before state cleanup in _settleTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter `amount` of removeLiquidity only carries the share amount reserved for removal and has no independent semantics.
Parameter `user` of _sendTokens is exactly the ETH recipient derived from msg.sender and is fully captured by _sendTokens.
Local `unsentETH` in _settleTokens is only the value handed to _sendTokens before the reservation is deleted.
